name: @qf-jarvis/model-reply-adapter
description: QF Jarvis model-gateway reply adapter foundation (QFJ-M4). A concrete implementation of the M2 ModelReplyPort that composes the existing @qf-jarvis/model-gateway: it translates an authority-safe reply plan into an exact gateway request, obtains a result through a narrow injected synchronous gateway invoker, and strictly validates the returned structured result, its provenance, and its citations into a bounded structured reply draft behind pre/post-gateway state gates. The existing gateway remains the only routing authority (no second router, no hard-coded provider/model id, no fallback, no activation, no rollout promotion). No live Groq/local call, no key/token/env, no network; no live Core; no WhatsApp/n8n/send; no persistence/DB; no knowledge retrieval; no semantic/vector/embedding/RAG. Model output is a draft/proposal input only, never a Core ACCEPTED, never sent/delivered/executed. Depends on @qf-jarvis/agent-runtime, @qf-jarvis/model-gateway, and zod.
